# 07_审查网页与前端组件

本目录对应项目中的官方文档来源和离线下载目标。

## React 审查网页基础栈

- 优先级：`MANDATORY`
- 项目职责：Bank Test Portal 和 Authoring Review Web
- 必读主题：React Components/Hooks、Vite Build、Router、Server State、Client UI State
- 官方文档：
  - https://react.dev/
  - https://vite.dev/guide/
  - https://reactrouter.com/home
  - https://tanstack.com/query/latest/docs/framework/react/overview
  - https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/
- 官方仓库：
  - https://github.com/facebook/react
  - https://github.com/vitejs/vite
  - https://github.com/remix-run/react-router
  - https://github.com/TanStack/query
  - https://github.com/pmndrs/zustand
- npm 包：
  - `react`
  - `react-dom`
  - `vite`
  - `react-router-dom`
  - `@tanstack/react-query`
  - `zustand`

## 前端组件、编辑器、图表与测试

- 优先级：`RECOMMENDED`
- 项目职责：表单、Monaco 代码审查、ECharts 报表和前端测试
- 必读主题：Form Validation、Table/Timeline、Monaco Diff Editor、Charts、Unit/Component Testing
- 官方文档：
  - https://ant.design/docs/react/introduce
  - https://react-hook-form.com/get-started
  - https://microsoft.github.io/monaco-editor/
  - https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/en/get-started/
  - https://vitest.dev/guide/
  - https://testing-library.com/docs/react-testing-library/intro/
- 官方仓库：
  - https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design
  - https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form
  - https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor
  - https://github.com/apache/echarts
  - https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest
  - https://github.com/testing-library/react-testing-library
- npm 包：
  - `antd`
  - `react-hook-form`
  - `monaco-editor`
  - `echarts`
  - `vitest`
  - `@testing-library/react`
  - `@testing-library/jest-dom`
